name: finikos
description: Read-only access to Finikos, the property-management platform for Italian short-term rentals.

interface.longDescription:
Finikos is the property-management platform for short-term rental managers in Italy. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to your Finikos workspace, so you can ask questions about your business in plain language.

What you can ask:
- Today's arrivals, departures and cleanings, or a summary of any day.
- Nightly prices per channel (Airbnb, Booking.com, direct site), availability, and the price each booked night was sold at.
- Competitor prices, market availability, city events and weather used by pricing.
- Bookings, guests and the status of the police registration (Alloggiati) for each stay.
- Revenue per property and per month, invoices and electronic invoices.
- Cleanings by day, cleaner and property.
- Direct booking site settings, listings, rates and orders.

How it works: you sign in with your Finikos account (OAuth). Each user sees only the data of their own organization, with the permissions of their Finikos account. The plugin is read-only: it cannot change prices, bookings or settings; changes are made in the Finikos app.

Requires an existing Finikos account with administrator access.
defaultPrompt: Who is arriving and leaving today?
Show my nightly prices for the next 14 days.
How much did I earn this month?

positive.description: Daily overview of arrivals and departures.
positive.prompt: Who is arriving and who is leaving today?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's check-ins and check-outs with apartment and guest name, read from the demo workspace. No invented data.

positive.description: Nightly prices across channels and the price each booked night was sold at.
positive.prompt: What are my nightly prices for Casa Navigli over the next 14 days, and at what price were the nights already booked sold?
positive.expected_behavior: A table per night with Airbnb / Booking.com / direct price and availability, and for booked nights the price sold per night.

positive.prompt: How much do the competitors of Casa Navigli cost? Am I above or below the market?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists similar properties with weekly weekday/weekend prices and compares them with the apartment's current price.

positive.description: Revenue summary for the current month.
positive.prompt: How much did I earn this month, and which apartment earned the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the totals exactly as returned by the backend (no recomputation) and names the top-earning apartment.

positive.description: Cleanings still to do and who is assigned.
positive.prompt: Which cleanings are still to do this week, and who is assigned to each one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pending cleanings by day with apartment and assigned cleaner.

negative.description: Write request. The plugin is read-only (all tools are GET behind the mcp.read scope); it must not attempt changes and should point the user to the Finikos app.
negative.prompt: Lower tonight's price on Airbnb to 80 euros.

negative.description: Data of another organization. Every token is bound to one organization; the assistant must say it can only see the user's own organization.
negative.prompt: Show me the bookings of our competitor agency Ourbnb.

negative.description: Request unrelated to the user's rentals. The plugin should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the sea in autumn.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads data from the user's existing Finikos account.

publication.release_notes: First public release. Read-only access to Finikos, the property-management platform for Italian short-term rentals: nightly prices per channel, sold prices, competitors and market data, bookings, guests and police registration status, cleanings, revenue, invoices and the direct booking site. Sign-in with Finikos credentials (OAuth, PKCE); each user sees only their own organization. No write operations.

it-IT.subtitle: Gestionale affitti brevi
it-IT.description:
Finikos è il gestionale per chi gestisce affitti brevi in Italia. Questo plugin dà a ChatGPT accesso in sola lettura al tuo spazio Finikos: fai domande sulla tua attività in linguaggio naturale.

Cosa puoi chiedere:
- Arrivi, partenze e pulizie di oggi, o il riepilogo di qualsiasi giorno.
- Prezzi per notte per canale (Airbnb, Booking.com, sito diretto), disponibilità e il prezzo a cui è stata venduta ogni notte prenotata.
- Prezzi dei concorrenti, disponibilità del mercato, eventi e meteo usati dai prezzi.
- Prenotazioni, ospiti e stato dell'invio Alloggiati di ogni soggiorno.
- Incassi per proprietà e per mese, fatture e fatture elettroniche.
- Pulizie per giorno, colf e proprietà.
- Impostazioni, annunci, tariffe e ordini del sito di prenotazione diretta.

Come funziona: accedi con il tuo account Finikos (OAuth). Ogni utente vede solo i dati della propria organizzazione, con i permessi del proprio account. Il plugin è in sola lettura: non può modificare prezzi, prenotazioni o impostazioni; le modifiche si fanno nell'app Finikos.

Richiede un account Finikos esistente con accesso da amministratore.
